shortTitle: AAST Core Competencies for Sleep Technologists
bestFor: Expected sleep-technologist competency areas including age-specific care, CO2 monitoring, HSAT, maintenance/cleaning/safety, pulse oximetry, PAP, patient assessment, PSG, scoring, education, and supplemental low-flow oxygen.
authorityBoundary: Use to define expected professional competency, not as a scoring rule, diagnostic criterion, treatment algorithm, or device instruction. Detailed rules come from current AASM/AAST technical sources, physician orders, facility policy, and manufacturer instructions.
copyrightUse: Use public competency titles, original summaries, and original learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial protected competency text.
